page.overview:
What is Battle of Berchest?

The Battle of Berchest saw the Sons and Daughters of Freedom liberate the planet Berchest from the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 21 BBY. While the details of the battle are unknown, it was known that the group managed to free other planets from Separatist rule as well.
